hero.title: Roles and Responsibilities in Village Development
hero.description: The Gram Panchayat administration plays an important role in planning village development, implementing government schemes, maintaining public services and addressing the needs of villagers.

roles.sectionTitle: The Backbone of Village Development: Roles and Responsibilities
roles.sectionDescription: The elected representatives and Gram Panchayat officials work together to ensure effective administration and the overall development of the village.

points.one: Preside over Gram Sabha meetings and monthly meetings.
points.two: Plan and implement village development schemes.
points.three: Supervise and oversee the functioning of the Gram Panchayat.
points.four: Sign government records and cheques as authorized.
points.five: Communicate the problems and concerns of villagers to the government.

points.one: Maintain Gram Panchayat records, files and documents.
points.two: Provide information about government schemes and implement them.
points.three: Collect taxes and maintain financial accounts.
points.four: Register births, deaths and marriages and issue certificates.
points.five: Prepare and maintain the proceedings and minutes of meetings.

points.one: Present the problems and concerns of their respective wards during meetings.
points.two: Monitor development works carried out in the village.
points.three: Encourage villagers to participate in Gram Sabha meetings.
points.four: Help ensure that government schemes reach people in need.
points.five: Help maintain peace and public order in the village.

committees.title: Various Gram Panchayat Committees
committees.description: Different committees focus on essential village services and community welfare to support the overall development of the village.

waterSupply.title: Water Supply Committee
waterSupply.description: Plans the storage and distribution of water to ensure proper water supply in the village.

healthNutrition.title: Health and Nutrition Committee
healthNutrition.description: Looks after the health and well-being of villagers and monitors Anganwadi activities.

disputeFree.title: Dispute-Free Village Committee
disputeFree.description: Works to resolve disputes within the village through mutual understanding and discussion.

education.title: Education Committee
education.description: Monitors the quality of education and the functioning of the Zilla Parishad school.
